concerns.text: Task T013 (Tool Validation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T005 (config.py) for the state file path and potentially external network state. If T005 is not completed first, T013 cannot execute the validation logic defined in config. Additionally, T013 is listed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but depends on T005 which is also in Phase 2; the parallel tag [P] is misleading if T005 must run first to provide configuration.

Task T014 (Static Analysis) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T010 (Repo Selection), T011 (Git History), and T013 (Tool Validation). The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies no dependencies. T014 must be sequential after T010, T011, and T013 complete.
Task T015a (Filtering) is marked [P] but depends on T014 (Static Analysis) and T011 (Git History). The [P] tag is incorrect. T015a cannot run in parallel with T014 or T011.
Task T015b (Sensitivity Analysis Prep) is marked [P] but depends on T015a (Filtering). The [P] tag is incorrect. T015b must run after T015a.
Task T020 (Correlation) is marked [P] but depends on T015a (Filtering) to provide the `unified_metrics.csv` input. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T021 (Meta-Analysis) is marked [P] but depends on T020 (Correlation) to provide the `r` values. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T022 (Sensitivity Analysis Aggregation) is marked [P] but depends on T015a and T020. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T028b (Report File) is marked [P] but depends on T020, T021, and T022. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T031 (Versioning) is marked [P] but depends on T028b. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T032a (Quickstart Creation) is marked [P] but depends on T007e (Quickstart Creation) which is in Phase 2. The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies no dependencies, but T032a is a refinement of T007e.
Task T033b (Streaming & Memory) is marked [P] but depends on T015a (Filtering). The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T034 (Batch Logic) is marked [P] but depends on T011 (Git History). The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T035 (Unit Tests) is marked [P] but depends on T015a (Filtering) to have the logic to test. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T036 (Quickstart Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T032a. The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T041 (Data Loader Hardening) is marked [P] but depends on T011 (Git History). The [P] tag is incorrect.
Task T042 (Dataset Sourcing) is marked [P] but depends on T010 (Repo Selection). The [P] tag is incorrect.

The 'Parallel Opportunities' section states 'All Setup tasks marked [P] can run in parallel' and 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel'. However, many tasks in Phase 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 are incorrectly marked [P] despite having explicit dependencies listed in their descriptions. This creates a false impression of parallelism and violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

Task T000b depends on T000a, but both are marked [X] (completed) and T000b is not marked [P]. This is correct. However, the 'Parallel Example' section incorrectly suggests T010, T011, and T013 can run in parallel. T013 (Tool Validation) depends on T005 (config), and T011 (Git History) depends on T010 (Repo Selection). T014 depends on T010, T011, T013. The example is misleading.
